evals.prompt: /step-by-step tengo que: decidir el nombre del flag, contestar a Ana sobre la fecha, mergear la PR 123 y revisar el ticket PROJ-1
evals.setup: Conversation in Spanish; the PR merge depends on nothing else.
pass_criteria: Output is in Spanish
A numbered checklist with item types and an order is shown
Order respects dependencies and urgency; rationale given only if non-obvious
The turn ends so the user can review the list; no card is delivered yet

evals.prompt: envía este correo a Ana y cambia el campo en Jira
evals.setup: Plan approved by the user; two execute items touching external systems.
pass_criteria: Detects two separate items
Each execute card states the action and expected result and asks 'Authorize?' immediately before running
Approving the plan is not treated as permission to send or edit Jira
Does not change a Jira ticket state or send anything before the specific confirmation

evals.prompt: revisa mi PR y dime: 1) ¿renombro el flag? 2) ¿añado test de integración? 3) ¿actualizo el README? 4) ¿abro ticket de cleanup? 5) ¿pido review a Ana?
evals.setup: User did not invoke the skill; the assistant's draft reply would contain these 5 independent numbered asks.
pass_criteria: Offers step-by-step in one short line and waits
Does not change format or send the 5 questions before acceptance
For only 2 trivial items, it just asks them without ceremony

evals.setup: Plan: I1 decide country, I2 execute draft depends_on I1 (pending), I3 inform. I1 still pending.
pass_criteria: Presents I1, not I2
After I1 is answered, updates the plan and the progress counter, and does not present I2 in the same turn

evals.prompt: A: opción 2. C: sí, adelante. D: la fecha es el viernes, pero no sé el equipo
evals.setup: Items A, B, C, D pending; current item A; D asks for date and team.
pass_criteria: Maps replies to A, C and the date part of D
Confirms A and C in one line and asks only about the missing team for D
Does not re-ask A or C
The clarification for D is the only card of the turn; no second card is shown

evals.setup: Valid saved plan with I1 done and I2 pending with an open prompt.
pass_criteria: Validates the plan against the template
States goal and position in one line
Repeats the open prompt exactly without marking it answered
Keeps I1 done; with a missing or invalid plan, says so and does not invent state

evals.prompt: esto depende de Finanzas, no puedo contestar hoy
evals.setup: Current item I3 is an answer item.
pass_criteria: Marks I3 blocked with blocked_on, and asks for resume_when instead of inventing it
Continues with an independent item
Does not promise automatic follow-up
Re-offers I3 at the final review

evals.prompt: añade dos tareas, pon la última primera y para
evals.setup: Plan stored and pinned; 4 items pending.
pass_criteria: Adds the items, applies the new order and shows where they went
Writes only to the pinned plan
On stop, pauses and preserves the plan without dropping anything
